jobs.title: Revenue Management Analyst
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 Revenue Analyst

 Manages rooms and function space inventory to ensure inventory is allocated and restricted properly to maximize revenue and profits for hotels in the market. Responsible for building rates, packages and hotel sales strategy information in the hotel(s)’ inventory systems. The position makes pricing and positioning recommendations for market hotels. Conducts analysis of revenue, profit and demand associated with hotel rooms and space inventory, and Food and Beverage revenues. Position contributes to forecasts, budgets, weekly and daily projections. Position critiques sales strategy effectiveness and prepares historical and future analysis of revenue and profit opportunities.

 The Ideal candidate must have:

 Min. 1 year experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area.,

 OR

 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting, Hospitality Management or related major.

 Experience in all of Marriott Systems – Oyv2, Marsha, Opera, CITY, RPO, PRP, Revenue Planning is preferred but not mandatory.

 Strong process driven mindset with experience in system integration and support.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex data, develop forecasts, identify key business trends, and create automated tools and reports to improve accuracy and decision-making.

 Ability to communicate in English with guest, management and employees to their understanding. Analyzes competitive sets, price positioning, seasonality, mix and displacement on a continuous basis.

 Assists hotel with pricing and provides input on business evaluation recommendations.

 Analyzes month end and other available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals.

 General knowledge and understanding of major functions of the Revenue Management, Reservations, Sales & Marketing and Finance Departments.

 Computer literate with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, data analysis, macros/VBA, and the ability to develop automated forecasting and analytical tools.

 Experience with ADP and PeopleSoft is preferred.

 Data coding experience is preferred.

 Assist in the management of rooms inventory to maximize cluster rooms revenue, as well as maintain accuracy of information and enhance automation efforts in reservation system. Assist in the preparation of competitive analysis and other supporting documents for presentation at market sales strategy meetings. Assist in managing room authorizations, rates, and restrictions, including communicating rate restrictions and strategy to properties. Perform all Revenue Management month end reporting and auditing and provide forward looking information for the purposes of forecasting, targeting need areas and balancing financial expectations. Accurately generate, process and update all property and market Revenue Management reports and serve as primary source for majority of reporting and analytical needs of the Revenue Management team. Assist with system maintenance including but not limited to, inputting rate hurdles, monitoring forecasted demand, updating group forecasting and running daily system checks. Assist with training of new associates as necessary on revenue management tools. Assist in the implementation of hotel sales strategies in the reservation and inventory systems.

 Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearances are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats; move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 35 pounds without assistance; stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

 At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Additional Information: This hotel is owned and operated by an independent franchisee, Seera Hospitality Company LLC . The franchisee is a separate company and a separate employer from Marriott International, Inc. If you accept a position at this hotel, you will be employed by a franchisee and not by Marriott International, Inc.

 Job Summary:

 Maintains the transient rooms inventory for the hotel(s) and responsible for maximizing transient revenue. The Revenue Manager releases group rooms back into general inventory and ensures clean booking windows for Marriott customers. The position recommends pricing and positioning of cluster properties. In addition, the position oversees the inventory management system to verify appropriateness of agreed upon selling strategies.

 JOB FAMILY

 CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 •

 Aligns Strategy and Market Trends - Updating market knowledge and aligning strategies and approaches accordingly.

 •

 Monitoring Actual vs. Projected Sales - Compiling information, analyzing and monitoring actual sales against projected sales.

 •

 Demonstrating Leadership - Utilizing interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

 •

 Achieving/Exceeding Goals - Achieving and exceeding goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.

 •

 Attending Strategy and Management Meetings - Attending meetings to plan, organize, prioritize, coordinate and manage activities and solutions.

 •

 Analyzing Data or Information - Identifying the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.

 •

 Developing Objectives and Strategies - Establishing long-range objectives and specifying the strategies and actions to achieve them.

 •

 Executing on a Strategy - taking a predetermined strategy and driving the execution of that strategy.

 •

 Demonstrating Knowledge - Demonstrating knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.

 •

 Making Decisions and Solving Problems - Analyzing information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

 •

 Interacting With Computers - Using computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.

 •

 Meeting the Needs of Key Stakeholders - Understanding and meeting the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).

 •

 Communicating Information Timely - Informing and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

 •

 Exploring Business Opportunities - Exploring opportunities that drive profit, create value for clients, and encourage innovation; challenging existing processes/systems/products to make improvements.

 •

 Generating and Delivering Accurate and Timely Results - Generating and providing accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.

 JOB SPECIFIC TASKS

 •

 Provides revenue management functional expertise to cluster general managers, leadership teams and market sales leaders.

 •

 Ensures hotel strategies conform to brand philosophies and initiatives.

 •

 Ensures that sales strategies and rate restrictions are communicated, implemented and modified as market conditions fluctuate.

 •

 Prepares sales strategy meeting agenda, supporting documentation.

 •

 Conducts sales strategy analysis and refines as appropriate to increase market share for all properties.

 •

 Communicates proactively with properties regarding rate restrictions and strategy.

 •

 Manages rooms inventory to maximize cluster rooms revenue.

 •

 Assists hotels with pricing and provides input on business evaluation recommendations.

 •

 Leads efforts to coordinate strategies between group sales offices.

 •

 Maintains accurate reservation system information.

 •

 Supports cluster selling initiatives by working with all reservation centers.

 •

 Uses reservations system and demand forecasting systems to determine, implement and control selling strategies.

 •

 Checks distribution channels for hotel positioning, information accuracy and competitor positioning.

 •

 Analyzes period end and other available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals.

 QUALIFICATIONS:

 •

 Minimum 3 years of Revenue Management experience in a 5-star hotel in Makkah or Madinah (mandatory).

 •

 Strong knowledge of the Hajj and Umrah hospitality market.

 •

 Experience in revenue optimization, pricing strategies, forecasting, and OTA management.

 •

 Fluent in Arabic with good English

jobs.title: Change Order and Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
In this role, your responsibilities will be:

 Change Orders

 Perform initial review of incoming Change Requests to determine process flow and how to handle change.

 Recognize the type of change entered and determine the level of action and how to proceed with items before sending them to the factory for processing.

 Work with internal stakeholders to determine and quote the cost and lead-time impact of the requested changes.

 Communicate with Emerson Impact Partners to resolve issues, notify them of the cost and lead-time impacts, and provide guidance on how to proceed with their change request including how the fees will be assessed.

 Verify that the appropriate department has made the appropriate changes, and the updates have been documented in the FLEX portal, to assign the request to the next department to ensure the correct flow of the procedure.

 Follow up the process and status of the change within each department involved in the process.

 Ensure new line has been entered correctly by the Impact partner to proceed with the changes

 Manages the ticker-orders dashboard to ensure correct process flow of change requests.

 Pricing

 Update pricing and commissions in Oracle and FF2 as needed.

 Investigate and resolve pricing errors and disputes.

 Ensure orders have been entered correctly per quotes provided.

 Cancel orders that were entered with incorrect pricing and let the Entry User know they need to re-enter it correctly.

 Have the authority to contact corrective billing to resolve pricing adjustments.

 Order Entry

 Enter and commit the orders that Impact Partners have transmitted in Rep Hold: fix unit and old price, tag, currency, deal and quantity errors, remove obsolete codes, enter no-charge orders, configure and set actuators and valves, change shipping information, entering change and expedites fees.

 Override and source the items from the correct prime ship as needed.

 Adjust and update the correct price on orders to match the quote already provided.

 Route emergency and service orders

 Error Correction

 Ensure communication between the Impact Partner and the production support, error correction and DevOps teams so orders can be successfully transmitted from FF2 to Oracle.

 Recognize the different errors and take action to correct and successfully transmit orders to the Oracle system, using tools and knowledge of FF2, XML files and Oracle.

 Continuous Improvement

 Identify and initiate continuous improvement efforts

 Who You Are

 You are a proactive and resilient professional who thrives in dynamic environments and embraces challenges with confidence. You enjoy solving problems, are naturally curious, and can move forward effectively even when direction or information may not be fully defined. You are highly collaborative, work well across multiple teams and stakeholders, and maintain a positive attitude when faced with obstacles or setbacks. Your strong communication skills and customer-focused mindset enable you to build effective working relationships across the organization and with external partners.

 For this role, you will need:

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 applications.

 Ability to quickly learn and utilize internal systems, tools, and business processes.

 Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.

 Ability to follow structured processes while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

 Foundational ability to learn and apply product knowledge.

 Confidence in managing ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.

 English proficiency equivalent to a TOEIC score of 700 or higher.

 Ability to interact effectively with a broad range of stakeholders, including customers, project management teams, order management teams, customer service representatives, manufacturing sites, support teams, and global business partners.

 Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

 Experience working in customer-facing, operations, order management, supply chain, sales support, or project coordination environment.

 Exposure to enterprise systems, business applications, or technical support platforms. Demonstrated ability to collaborate with multiple internal and external stakeholders to achieve business objectives.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a continuous improvement mindset.

 Proven ability to remain effective and make sound decisions in situations involving uncertainty or changing requirements.

 Experience supporting cross-functional teams within a global organization.

 Self-motivated, results-oriented, and driven to continuously learn and develop new skills.

 Job Competencies

 Manages Ambiguity

 Collaborates

 Manages Conflict

 Decision Quality

 Persuades

 Our Offer To You:

 We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing and know that to do your best you must have flexible, competitive benefits plans

Senior Specialist, Strategy Pricing & Interchange

This role will help shape how Mastercard translates product, service, and customer value into scalable pricing strategies, business cases, and decision-ready analytics.
The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, pricing analytics, and data science, combined with the ability to influence commercial decisions. 3.	Machine Learning & Advanced Analytics

jobs.description:
ClarusONE Sourcing Services, LLP, provides strategic generic pharmaceutical services for both Walmart Stores, Inc. and McKesson Corporation. Its’ mission is to enable access to affordable medicines, which it has successfully been doing since its inception in 2016.

 ClarusONE is a joint venture between Walmart and McKesson, two of the top 10 biggest corporations in the USA, according to the Fortune 500 list. They have more than two decades of history working together to improve the quality and lower the cost of pharmaceutical care to patients. This partnership leverages McKesson’s demonstrated strength and expertise in global pharmaceutical sourcing in conjunction with Walmart’s strength and commitment to delivering leading health and wellness services to their customers.

 ClarusONE Sourcing Services is headquartered in London and prides itself on its can-do attitude that has ensured millions of Americans pay less when buying generic pharmaceuticals every day.

 About the Role:

 The Associate Pricing Analyst will support the Pricing & Commercial Operations Lead and act as a central analytical and commercial resource for pricing across the Sourcing organisation. The role will combine accurate execution of pricing activity with proactive identification, analysis and delivery of pricing opportunities across suppliers, products and sourcing programmes.

 The Pricing Analyst will evaluate supplier pricing behaviour, market dynamics, pricing-rule adherence and member economics to identify commercial risks and value opportunities. The role will develop fact-based supplier negotiation strategies, lead defined pricing discussions within agreed authority levels, and support broader initiatives to strengthen pricing consistency, supplier accountability and commercial outcomes.

 The position will also contribute to the continued development of ClarusONE’s pricing framework, analytics capabilities and supplier-management approach, helping ensure that pricing rules remain commercially effective, operationally practical and aligned with member objectives.

 What You'll Do:

 • Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers and key stakeholders to support commercial objectives.
• Prepare negotiation strategies through analysis of historical pricing, market intelligence, supplier performance, and commercial benchmarks.

• Develop regular reporting that distinguishes submitted activity from value influenced or delivered by the pricing function.
• Produce regular reporting on pricing trends, savings delivery, supplier performance, and procurement initiatives.
• Measure and communicate the financial impact of projects, negotiations, and process improvements.
• Develop supplier scorecards and performance metrics to evaluate commercial performance, responsiveness, reliability, and compliance.
• Monitor supplier activity and identify indicators of commercial risk, value leakage, or performance concerns.

 Basic Requirements:

 • Typically, minimum 0-2 years of relevant experience. May have degree or equivalent.
• Experience in pricing, commercial analytics, strategic sourcing, finance and/or supplier management.
• Demonstrated ability to convert complex datasets into commercial actions and recommendations.
• Experience preparing for or participating in supplier or customer negotiations.
• Experience assessing financial impact, constructing commercial scenarios and tracking realised value.
• Pharmaceutical, healthcare distribution, procurement or generic-drug market experience preferred.
• Experience delivering analytical or process-improvement projects across multiple function.

 Preferred Skills/Experience:

• Advanced Excel capability and working knowledge of BI, dashboarding or analytical tools.
• Ability to analyse pricing at product, family, supplier and portfolio levels.

• Effective negotiation, influencing and challenge skills.
• Ability to operate within legal, contractual and confidentiality guardrails when providing supplier pricing guidance. Existing guidance materials specifically emphasise avoiding disclosure of one supplier’s pricing or how guidance was derived.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Deal Desk
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.



Deepgram is hiring a Senior Manager, Deal Desk to build our deal desk from the ground up and run it. Deepgram is a usage-based voice AI platform (speech-to-text, text-to-speech and the Voice Agent API), sold through self-serve plans, enterprise commitments and cloud marketplaces. You'll report to the Chief Accounting Officer and work daily with leaders in Sales, Customer Success, Product and Finance.



The desk is not a control function. Its job is to help Sales win better deals faster, at prices we can defend.



What you'll do

 - Build the desk: approval matrix, pre-approved playbook, and credit and promo guidelines, so most deals need no approval.

 - Run it day to day: review non-standard deals and give same-day answers.

 - Shape large deals early: commitment size, ramps, product mix and terms.

 - Partner with Product and sales leadership on pricing and packaging.

 - Build pricing insight: deal margin, realized discount, and win rate by discount band.

 - Keep deals clean and audit-ready, with approvals and terms recorded in Salesforce.

 - Use AI to run the desk: an agent does the first-pass review; you make the call and improve the rules.

 - Build out CPQ in Salesforce so the playbook and approvals live in the quote.

 - Partner with Customer Success on renewals at first, then take ownership of renewals as the desk matures.



What you'll need

 - 6+ years in deal desk, deal strategy or pricing at a B2B technology company, with 3+ running a desk.

 - Usage-based pricing experience: commitments, credits, overage, ramps and rollover.

 - A desk, matrix or playbook you built that sales adopted.

 - Financial fluency, including how deal terms affect revenue recognition.

 - Hands-on experience building Salesforce CPQ, plus SQL.

 - Credibility with sales executives, clear writing, and an AI-native way of working you can show.



Nice to have

 - Infrastructure, API or AI company experience.

 - Pre-IPO experience.

 - Cloud marketplace private offers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

 - Has owned or run renewals.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com http://deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.title: QR039 - Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a motivated Pricing Analyst (24-month fixed-term contract) to join our team. You will play an important role in delivering analytical insights, developing commercial opportunities, and delivering efficient and effective pricing processes right across the APAC region. As part of the Quantum program, you will also support the transition of pricing processes and data from Movex to SAP.

 This role will suit a commercially minded individual, you will support accurate, timely and effective pricing execution. You will maintain pricing data, implement scheduled price changes, produce analysis and reporting, and provide responsive support to stakeholders across the APAC region. . You will have a real opportunity to make an impact in a business with considerable scale locally and globally. While base level pricing skills are required, it will be your ability to engage with the right stakeholders and partner with them to deliver commercial insights that will define your success.

 In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

 •
 Maintain accurate pricing data in the Movex system, including account setup, data validation and issue resolution.

 •
 Support and implement scheduled mid-year and full-year pricing actions, ensuring changes are completed accurately and communicated to relevant stakeholders.

 •
 Contribute to pricing improvement and analytical projects, including competitive pricing and price-performance analysis.

 •
 Prepare clear reports, analysis and insights to support pricing and commercial decisions.

 •
 Provide timely, practical support to internal stakeholders on day-to-day pricing queries and issues.

 •
 Handle confidential and commercially sensitive information appropriately.

 To be successful in this role you will need the following:

 • A university degree, or equivalent qualification, in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Business, Marketing, Accounting or a related discipline is highly desirable.

• At least 1 year of relevant experience, ideally in pricing, commercial analysis or a related analytical role within a medium-to-large organisation.

• Sound financial and commercial understanding, with the ability to translate data into practical insights.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with large or ambiguous data sets from multiple sources.

• A high level of accuracy and attention to detail, including the ability to identify anomalies, gaps and unmatched data.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trusted and cooperative working relationships.

• A proactive approach to managing priorities, building networks across the APAC region and delivering work with limited supervision after onboarding.

• Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across Pricing, Finance, Product Management and Sales.

• The ability to learn new systems, with SAP pricing experience highly regarded but not essential.

 Our culture believes in POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL . We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what #LifeAtCummins is all about.

jobs.description:
You’ll shape how a global bank prices deposits - where data, strategy, and market dynamics meet. In this role, you’ll turn complex, multi-currency portfolios into clear pricing recommendations and product insights that influence senior stakeholders. You’ll partner across teams, build scalable data foundations, and elevate analytics that improve decision-making. If you’re energized by ownership, curiosity, and impact, you’ll find meaningful growth and mobility here.

 As an Associate in the Global Deposit Pricing and Strategy team, you will drive analytics and pricing strategy for a global deposit portfolio across multiple products, currencies, and platforms. You will translate macroeconomic and interest-rate dynamics into practical pricing actions, supported by strong data and clear storytelling. You will build and improve the data assets and reporting that power monthly performance review and decision forums. You will collaborate closely with partners across lines of business to align pricing approaches and deliver stronger client and business outcomes.

 Job Responsibilities

 • Develop and institutionalize process to maintain an analytical source of truth for deposits data – account/client attributes & performance every month, for new and existing book.
• Apply data-driven approaches to help create, refresh, and maintain pricing strategies for all deposit products in GPB’s global deposit business.
• Design and deliver analytical projects that align to business priorities and profitability levers
• Develop and enhance data models to enable scalable, repeatable analytics for current and future needs
• Perform in-depth analytics of prevailing pricing across clients and products, leveraging quantitative techniques to recommend rate changes and present findings at scheduled forums.
• Maintain existing data pipelines in Python and/or Alteryx and create new pipelines to support ongoing analytics and reporting
• Lead monthly pricing forums by setting the agenda, preparing decision materials, and recommending actions supported by data
• Design, build, and maintain advanced models and analytical workflows to evaluate the impact of pricing changes on book volumes and net interest income, supporting incremental profitability assessments.
• Collaborate with other business lines to understand and align pricing strategies, sharing analytical insights to support decision-making.

 Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

 • 4+ years of experience in financial services, with a strong focus on analytics supporting the Banking business.
• Background in financial services/lending & treasury, within Wealth Management, with hands-on experience in data analysis and modelling.
• Structured problem solving – Identify issues, define clear problem statements, arrive at hypotheses, develop frameworks, pull data to unambiguously prove or disprove these hypotheses.
• Storyboarding & Presentation – Strong written and verbal communication skills to communicate problem-solving approach, framework and recommendations.
• Data & Quantitative analysis – Strong proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, SQL, Python, Tableau, Alteryx.
• Should be comfortable to write medium to advanced-level queries without taking help from LLMs , for complex queries they can use LLMs.
• Intellectual curiosity – demonstrated eagerness/aptitude to learn about global macroeconomics, short-term yield trends, recent developments in analytical modelling that study client behavior.
• Team player with positive attitudes towards new tasks, dealing with obstacles in daily tasks, details oriented and willingness to put in additional efforts.

 Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

 • Strategic and analytical thinker with a drive towards execution and results.
• Influencing skills to manage a variety of stakeholders from different functions.
• Team player who proactively shares knowledge and information within and outside the function and can manage other team members.

Pricing

 Job Category:

Bogotá, Distrito Capital, Colombia, São Paulo, Brazil

 Job Description:

 Lead the LATAM Pricing Operations shared-services backbone, centralizing and standardizing operational execution while Business Units retain ownership of pricing strategy, customer price setting, and commercial decisions. The role manages end-to-end pricing ERP and sales deal management activities, an operational team, SOX control execution, and a transformation agenda focused on automation, data programming, simplification, scalability, and business continuity.

 Key Responsibilities:

 1. Pricing ERP and Core Process Ownership

 • Own operational execution across base prices, portfolio definition, price-code setting, ERP price creation and maintenance, system contract management, overrides, and pricing dispute workflows.
• Ensure accurate and timely execution across supported countries, entities, channels, customer hierarchies, and sold-to structures.
• Coordinate dependencies with Master Data, Finance, Commercial, Deliver, IT, and BU Pricing teams, with clear requestor, approver, and executor responsibilities.
• Maintain process documentation, standard work, backup coverage, knowledge transfer, and business-continuity plans for critical pricing operations.

 2. Sales Deal Management Operations

 • Lead the operational lifecycle of approved customer negotiations, from intake and validation through ERP upload, contract maintenance, effective-date control, monitoring, and closure.
• Administer workflow queues and service levels, prioritize closing-period and business-critical requests, and provide transparent status reporting to stakeholders.
• Monitor exceptions, incomplete requests, approval gaps, duplicate agreements, expired conditions, and execution discrepancies; drive resolution with accountable owners.
• Preserve BU authority for commercial negotiation and approval while ensuring compliant, accurate, and traceable system execution.

 3. Automation, Data Programming and Simplification

 • Build and execute a multiyear automation roadmap that reduces manual activities, cycle time, rework, and key-person dependency across Pricing Operations.
• Use data-programming and analytics capabilities such as SQL, Python, Power Query, Power BI, workflow automation, APIs, or approved equivalent platforms to automate validations, reconciliations, controls, and reporting.
• Design exception-based operations, automated quality gates, audit trails, alerts, and dashboards for pricing transactions and controls.
• Partner with IT and process owners to translate business requirements into scalable ERP enhancements, workflow solutions, and controlled deployments with testing and hypercare.

 4. SOX Controls, Compliance and Audit Readiness

 • Own the operational execution and evidence quality of pricing-related SOX controls, including access, approval, completeness, accuracy, change, and reconciliation controls as applicable.
• Embed controls into workflows and system logic wherever feasible, replacing retrospective manual checks with preventive or automated controls.
• Maintain complete, timely, and retrievable documentation for internal audit, external audit, and compliance reviews; remediate findings through sustainable root-cause solutions.
• Monitor segregation of duties, approval matrices, override governance, emergency changes, and high-risk exceptions, escalating control failures promptly.

 5. Team Leadership and Service Management

 • Lead, coach, and develop a regional operational team with clear roles, objectives, backup coverage, capability plans, and performance expectations.
• Operate through a centralized intake and workflow model with documented SLAs, escalation paths, workload balancing, and service-performance reviews.
• Create a continuous-improvement culture using process mapping, root-cause analysis, standard work, automation backlogs, and benefits tracking.

jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role

 We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own how Elastic Security is packaged, priced, and sold on Elastic Cloud Serverless.

 More customers want to run SIEM, endpoint, and cloud security on Serverless, and the commercial model decides whether that growth is profitable. You will own the security solution layer on top of the Serverless platform: the tiers, the meters, the margins, and what it is like for a customer to pay for security on a consumption model. The Platform team owns the underlying architecture. You will work with them so that what we sell can be delivered at a healthy margin and quoted with confidence.

 We are changing how we price and package, and you will help design the new model. You own the pricing recommendation, and executive executive team makes the final call.

 The role sits between Product, Finance, Engineering, Sales, and Product Marketing. Expect to explain to a CISO, a CFO, and a field seller why a SKU looks the way it does.

 What You Will Be Doing

•
 Redesign how Security is packaged and priced on Serverless. Define the tiers, feature entitlements, and usage meters, select what is bundled, metered, or sold as an add-on, test the options against customer demand and COGS, and bring a recommendation to senior executive team.

•
 Own margin. Work with the Platform team and Finance to model the cost of new security capabilities, including ingest, search, retention, endpoint, and AI features, and set pricing requirements before a feature ships.

•
 Grow Security on Serverless from proof of concept to renewal. You are accountable for new workloads, migrations from hosted and self-managed deployments, expansion, and retention. Work with Finance to separate recurring growth from one-time proof-of-concept revenue.

•
 Give customers control over cost and performance. Define how search configurations, data tiers, and retention work for security use cases, and bring the cost models that justify new platform levers. Keep tenant-level packaging consistent with the Product Manager for MSSP and multi-tenancy.

•
 Simplify how customers understand cost. Cut packaging complexity first, then simplify the sizing and pricing estimators that customers and Solutions Architects use. Agree on a measure of "simple," such as time to a credible quote, and track it.

•
 Turn pricing decisions into shipped product. Write the PRDs and PRFAQs, and lead the work across Security engineering, the Serverless Platform team, Billing and Metering, and Cloud Operations. Help build the frameworks and reviews that other Security PMs, Product Marketing, and Solutions Architects use to price new capabilities.

•
 Stay close to the market and the field. Discuss with customers and prospects about what they will and won't pay for, track how other security platforms package and price, and help the field explain when Serverless, hosted, or self-managed is the right fit.

•
 You know the main approaches to pricing AI features, such as token-based, credit-based, and per-action or outcome pricing, and how inference costs and unpredictable usage shape each one.

 What You Bring

•
 You have led pricing and packaging for a SaaS or cloud product end to end, from option design and customer testing through margin modeling and executive approval, and you can point to the revenue, margin, or adoption result. Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing is required, as is experience simplifying a model that had grown too complex.

•
 Product experience with SIEM, XDR, endpoint, cloud security, or a security operations platform is a solid plus, and so is a background as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. If your pricing work was on another cloud or data product, the team will help you learn the security side.

•
 You are comfortable with COGS, gross margin, and ARR modeling, and you can build a forecast with Finance without a translator.

•
 You understand how multi-tenant cloud services are built and how architecture choices drive cost, well enough to read a technical design.

•
 You lead through influence in a matrixed, remote-first company. You get enable teams to agree on a decision, work well asynchronously, and shift between priorities when the business changes.

•
 You can present pricing to a CISO and a procurement team, and you have supported deals

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager I, Base Pricing
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative, strategic, and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry.

 Pricing is the primary economic engine of Lyft's marketplace — a high-precision, real-time system that processes millions of fare calculations per hour, balancing rider affordability, driver earnings, and Lyft's sustainable growth. The Pricing team sits at the intersection of the marketplace, mediating between rider demand and driver supply, and is a core pillar of the Rider Organization.

 The Base Pricing Team owns the systems that set the base price of a Lyft ride for every ride type, region, and ride intent. Behind these base prices is a machine-learning and optimization stack that predicts how the Lyft marketplace responds to price, translates the cost of serving a ride into a price, and recommends price changes across hundreds of markets every week. Base prices are the foundation of every fare, and they set the reference point that dynamic pricing and rider discounts build on.

 The team serves two sets of customers: riders, who should see prices that are fair, competitive, and matched to what they value; and the analysts and market managers who use our models and tools to set pricing strategy.

 Responsibilities:

 As the Staff Product Manager for Base Pricing, you will own the vision and roadmap for how Lyft sets base prices, and define the success metrics that measure it. That includes:

• Determining the optimal granularity at which Lyft sets base prices (e.g., by time, location, and type of trip)

• Improving how our base price optimization engine works with downstream dynamic pricing systems to better respond to real-time market conditions

• Re-evaluating how costs to fulfill a ride impact prices

• Jointly optimizing prices across ride types, so that standard, alternative modes, and scheduled rides are priced as one portfolio

• Making our impact estimation models accurate and trusted by market management teams

• Evolving base pricing to function in a hybrid network with autonomous vehicles

• Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders (engineers, scientists, analysts), and partner teams (Driver Earnings, Verticals, Market Management) to align on a shared vision, define requirements, and prioritize inbound requests.

• Communicate roadmaps, experiment results, and pricing decisions clearly to audiences from partner teams up to Lyft's executive team.

 Experience:

• 5+ years of product management or relevant experience, with significant time spent on algorithmic, data-driven, pricing, or marketplace products

• A deep technical understanding of microeconomics, and ideally a background in Operations Research, Econometrics, Machine Learning, or algorithmic systems

• Experience owning pricing, revenue management, or other economic levers with direct P&L impact; experience with price optimization, elasticity modeling, or cost modeling is a strong plus

• Experience running A/B tests and market-level experiments, using statistical and causal inference techniques to evaluate results, and developing post-launch testing strategies

• Experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization; comfortable working directly in SQL and with data science partners on model design

• Ability to define and analyze metrics that inform the success of products, and excellent judgment about the dynamics of a product ecosystem

• Natural ability to make things happen around you; you manage ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies across many teams in an organized and structured way

• Strong communication skills and intuition for communication strategy at every level — within teams, within the company, and with executives

• Passion for Lyft and what we are trying to achieve in sustainable urban transportation

 Benefits:

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Child care and pet benefits

• 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

• In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

• 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary

Manager, Data Scientist -Financial Services- Pricing

 Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

 As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

 In this role, you will:

 • Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
• Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
• Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
• Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

 The Ideal Candidate is:

 • Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.

• Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
• Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
• A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

 Basic Qualifications:

 • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date: • A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analytics
• A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analytics
• A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analytics

• At least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
• At least 1 year of experience working with machine learning
• At least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

 Preferred Qualifications

 • PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analytics
• At least 1 year of experience working with AWS
• At least 4 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysis
• At least 4 years’ experience with machine learning
• At least 4 years’ experience with SQL

jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

 Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

 By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

 WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

 Box is evolving in terms of pricing and packaging – taking our more straightforward, seat-based model and augmenting it with API-call-base and AI-driven consumption. The Director, Pricing & Packaging will help Box navigate the shift from traditional enterprise software pricing towards consumption-based pricing tied to AI usage, units, platform activity, costs, and business value.

 The impact of this leader will be both strategic and operational. They will bring analytical rigor to pricing model design while helping cross-functional teams align around recommendations, tradeoffs, and implementation. Success will depend not only on building the right model, but also on clearly articulating the business context and strategy behind pricing recommendations to senior leaders.

 This is an individual contributor role reporting into our Vice President, Product Marketing. This role will be hybrid based in our Redwood City, CA global HQ three days per week.

 YOUR IMPACT AT BOX

 The Director, Pricing & Packaging will own a strategic and execution-oriented pricing function focused on helping Box modernize its pricing approach. Key responsibilities include:

•
 Lead the evolution of Box’s pricing model from a primarily seat-based approach to more complex platform, usage, and AI consumption-based models.

•
 Develop pricing models for AI usage and consumption units that make sense for Box’s business as the traditional seat-unit model becomes less central.

•
 Partner closely with key stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Finance, Controllership, GTM, and executive leadership to roll out pricing models that are analytically sound and commercially viable.

•
 Build rigorous pricing analyses using strong quantitative skills, including modeling, spreadsheets, regression, intake analysis, cost considerations, and business-case development.

•
 Translate complex pricing work into a clear business story that helps executives and partner teams understand the recommendation, rationale, tradeoffs, and expected impact.

•
 Operate effectively in ambiguity, bringing structure to complex, evolving problems where the path forward may not yet be fully defined.

•
 Drive alignment and implementation, not just strategy, by working through operational challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and bringing stakeholders along.

•
 Understand and articulate how AI models are priced, why those pricing structures matter, and how they affect Box’s business economics.

 WHO YOU ARE

 Box executives are engaged, passionate leaders who prioritize customer centricity, innovation, and growth. As an AI-first company, XLT members bring a growth mindset and proactively leverage AI to make faster, smarter decisions that amplify their impact across the business.

 As a leader in this role, you have/are:

•
 Highly quantitative skill set, including comfort with pricing modeling, spreadsheets, regression, cost analysis, and structured business analysis.

•
 Strong pricing and packaging expertise, ideally in enterprise SaaS, AI, platform pricing, or usage-based pricing environments.

•
 Strong understanding of AI-related pricing dynamics, including how AI models are priced, why those pricing structures matter, and how they affect business economics.

•
 Ability to do the analytical work directly, not only manage or advise on it.

•
 Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to articulate pricing recommendations clearly to executives and cross-functional partners.

•
 Influence and stakeholder-management skills, especially in ambiguous situations where teams may have competing priorities or resistance to change.

•
 Ability to operationalize strategy, ensuring recommendations move beyond a deck

jobs.title: Deal Desk Analyst
jobs.description:
Alloy is where you belong!

 Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces , Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers , Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker , year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here .

 About the team

 Revenue Operations is a small team with outsized reach. Deal Desk is the part of RevOps closest to the deal: we help reps structure pricing, build quotes, and move contracts through approval so they can close faster without giving away margin. As Alloy sells into more banks, credit unions, fintechs, and channel partners, more deals come through the desk every quarter, and they're getting more varied. This role reports to the Senior Revenue Operations Manager, Deal Desk, and will be the second person on the desk.

 Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

 What you'll be doing

 You'll be the first stop for reps working through the mechanics of a deal: building and checking quotes, keeping the approval queue moving, and making sure what gets signed is what gets booked and billed. It's a high-volume, detail-heavy seat with a front-row view of how Alloy prices, packages, and contracts, and a lot of room to make the process better as you learn it.

• Build and review quotes from Salesforce CPQ all the way through the Ironclad workflow process, checking that products, pricing, terms, and opportunity setup (new business, renewal, amendment, upsell, channel) are correct before they move forward.

• Work the twice-daily Ironclad approval queue alongside Legal and Accounting, reviewing order forms against our standard terms and Deal Desk Levers and flagging anything non-standard.

• Support the triage of incoming requests in Deal Desk, Ironclad, and the Rev Ops Help queues, confirm each one has the context needed for review, and route it to the right person.

• Manage first-pass pricing using our pricing calculator and guidelines, so senior Deal Desk time goes to large and novel deals.

• Partner with our Systems and Salesforce admins to improve CPQ and quoting workflows: flag where reps get stuck, document requirements for fixes and enhancements, test changes before they go live, and update guides once they ship.

• Review closed-won contracts for booking accuracy (ACV, CARR, term, billing frequency, uplifts) and keep the bookings tracker current.

• Pull weekly reporting on deals in flight, request volume, turnaround time, and discount and approval trends.

• Help maintain CPQ, Ironclad, and Deal Desk process, and turn repeat questions into documentation (CPQ Handbook)

 Who we’re looking for

 Must-haves:

• 1-3 years in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Order Management, or a similar analytical role supporting a sales team.

• Hands on Salesforce experience with opportunities, quotes, and reports.

• Salesforce CPQ (or similar) experience.

• Interest in automating manual deal desk work.

• Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

• Sharp attention to detail, with a habit of catching the wrong date or mismatched number before it reaches a customer.

• Comfort working a queue: many requests at once, prioritized by deadline, with people kept informed along the way.

• Clear, direct written communication, including explaining a policy to a rep or saying "not yet" without creating friction.

• Curiosity about how deals work, from pricing and contract terms to how they flow into bookings and billing.

 Nice-to-haves:

• Experience with Ironclad or another contract lifecycle management tool.

• Experience gathering requirements or testing changes for a CRM or quoting tool.

• Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or financial services.

• Familiarity with SaaS metrics and deal terms such as ARR, CARR, usage-based pricing, ramps, and multi-year uplifts.

• Exposure to order forms, billing, or revenue recognition basics (ASC 606).

• Familiarity with SQL.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

 As a Data Scientist for Choice's Revenue Management Agentic Systems and Pricing Analytics team, you will use AI, data science, and revenue management expertise to solve pricing, forecasting, and commercial performance questions at the brand, market, and hotel/property level. You will design, build, test, and deploy agentic AI frameworks that support pricing analysis, demand forecasting, elasticity measurement, dynamic pricing recommendations, and causal inference analytics. You will partner with Revenue Management, Pricing, Analytics, Product, and Technology teams to convert business questions into scalable models, agents, and decision-support tools that improve key KPIs such as RevPAR, RPI, ADR, occupancy, and competitive price position. This individual-contributor role will develop predictive models, evaluate pricing and promotional strategies, and help modernize RM workflows through the responsible use of AI platforms such as Claude, Copilot, and OpenAI. The role requires hands-on experience with model development, validation, agent rollouts, and production-ready analytics that improve pricing strategy and revenue outcomes.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

 Agentic AI Systems, Model Operations and Data Engineering

 • Design, develop, test, and roll out agentic AI frameworks that support Revenue Management and pricing workflows, including agents for pricing diagnostics, demand signals, competitive insights, and recommendation support.
• Build and maintain data pipelines, feature stores, model-ready datasets, and analytical tools using SQL, Python, and approved enterprise data sources.
• Implement responsible AI patterns for agent orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, prompt/version control, guardrails, token throttling, and hierarchical model routing.
• Use AI platforms such as Claude, CoWork, Copilot, and OpenAI to prototype, deploy, and scale agents in partnership with Technology, Product, and Analytics teams.
• Create system health and model performance KPIs for AI-enabled RM solutions, including adoption, latency, accuracy, quality, cost efficiency, and business impact.

 Predictive Forecasting, Elasticity, Dynamic Pricing and Causal Analytics

 • Develop and validate predictive demand forecasting models for short-term and long-term revenue management planning at the brand, market, and hotel/property level.
• Estimate price elasticity, demand sensitivity, booking pace, segmentation behavior, and competitive response to inform pricing strategy and rate recommendations.
• Apply causal inference, experiment design, A/B testing, uplift measurement, and statistical validation to evaluate pricing, promotional, and RM initiatives.
• Analyze historical and forward-looking data to identify patterns, trends, and revenue opportunities that improve RevPAR, RPI, ADR, and occupancy.
• Translate model outputs into clear recommendations, visualizations, and executive-ready insights for Revenue Management and Pricing stakeholders.

 Revenue Management Strategy, Competitive Analysis and Stakeholder Delivery

 • Perform competitive analysis using internal and external market signals to guide pricing strategy at the brand, market, and hotel/property level.
• Identify opportunities to improve RevPAR, RPI, ADR, occupancy, price position, and revenue capture through scalable pricing analytics and RM decision support.
• Partner with Revenue Management, Pricing, Brand, Product, Operations, and Technology teams to prioritize use cases based on business value, feasibility, and adoption impact.
• Develop business cases, analytical readouts, implementation plans, and stakeholder materials that support commercial decisions and RM transformation initiatives.
• Manage intake of analytical and AI-agent requests, define success metrics, and support deployment, training, change management, and post-launch measurement.

 QUALIFICATIONS:

 Employment Experience

 • 2+ years of professional experience using structured and unstructured data to perform statistical analysis, build predictive models, and provide business insights.
• Hands-on experience developing predictive demand forecasting, price elasticity, dynamic pricing, causal inference, experimentation, and machine learning models.
• Demonstrated experience building, deploying, or operationalizing AI agents or agentic workflows using Claude, CoWork, Copilot, OpenAI, or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
• Experience with token throttling, hierarchical model routing, model evaluation, prompt/version management, guardrails, monitoring, and responsible AI practices for production or business-facing agents.

 Technical Skills

 • High proficiency in Python, SQL, and/or R, with experience using supervised and unsupervised learning methods, statistical modeling, feature engineering, validation, and testing.
• Experience with ML frameworks or libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, Scikit-Learn, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel is a plus.
• Professional experience

jobs.title: Senior Director, Pricing Analytics
jobs.description:
The Senior Director, Pricing Strategy leads the enterprise pricing analytics, forecasting, and revenue management technology functions to improve revenue performance across brands, regions, and individual properties. This leader establishes pricing strategy and guardrails, translates portfolio-level analysis into actionable property-level decisions, and oversees short-term and long-term revenue forecasting. The role leads the modernization of pricing, forecasting, and reporting capabilities through revenue management systems, analytics tools, and generative artificial intelligence. Working across Brand, Corporate Strategy, Advanced Analytics, Technology, and Finance teams, this position communicates pricing strategy and portfolio performance to executives, franchisees, and other stakeholders.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

 Pricing Strategy, Analytics, and Forecasting

 • Lead the enterprise pricing analytics function and identify demand, pricing, and revenue opportunities across the hotel portfolio at the brand, regional, and individual-property levels.
• Establish enterprise rate strategy and pricing guardrails by chain scale and brand, partnering with regional revenue management leaders to convert portfolio insights into property-level actions.
• Analyze rate, demand, price elasticity, competitive positioning, and market trends to identify pricing gaps and revenue opportunities.
• Own quarterly revenue forecasts across the enterprise, brands, regions, and properties, and partner with Advanced Analytics and Finance to develop annual forecasts.
• Quantify the effect of revenue-generating programs, commercial initiatives, and changes in market conditions on forecasted and actual performance.
• Build and maintain scorecards, dashboards, and diagnostic tools that provide timely visibility into pricing, demand, and revenue opportunities.
• Communicate pricing strategy, forecasts, portfolio performance, industry trends, and recommended actions to executives, franchisees, and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Apply generative artificial intelligence and modern analytics capabilities to accelerate insight generation, automate recurring analysis, and improve the speed and quality of decision-making.

 Revenue Management Technology and Infrastructure

 • Serve as the business owner for revenue management, pricing optimization, and rate management technologies.
• Establish and prioritize product roadmaps for new and enhanced pricing and analytics capabilities in partnership with Technology teams.
• Ensure that supporting data infrastructure provides reliable, detailed pricing and demand information across brands, regions, and properties.
• Lead the development and adoption of generative artificial intelligence-enabled tools that standardize and automate revenue tracking and reporting across commercial functions.
• Identify, pilot, and scale technology use cases that improve pricing, forecasting, reporting, and decision-making.
• Manage relationships, contracts, product use, and performance for third-party revenue management and data-service providers.
• Partner with Finance to evaluate competitive pricing for systems and services and manage the associated profit-and-loss responsibilities.

 People and Organizational Leadership

 • Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for pricing analytics, forecasting, and revenue management technology.
• Establish team priorities, workforce plans, operating objectives, and performance expectations that support departmental and enterprise goals.
• Build an effective team structure and ensure the capabilities and resources necessary to deliver planned results.
• Provide management guidance and functional expertise to direct reports, cross-functional partners, and adjacent teams.
• Build collaborative relationships across Brand, Corporate Strategy, Advanced Analytics, Technology, Finance, Revenue Management, Marketing, and Sales.
• Anticipate complex operational and financial challenges, determine appropriate actions, and position the function to address emerging business needs.
• Contribute to department strategy and operating plans in partnership with Vice President and senior leadership stakeholders.

 QUALIFICATIONS:

 Employment Experience

 • At least 8 years of progressive experience in revenue management, pricing analytics, forecasting, financial analysis, or a related discipline.
• At least 4 years of experience in performance analytics, strategy, or financial analysis.

AS A SENIOR DIRECTOR, WW DEAL DESK AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Lead, scale and develop a global team of Deal Desk professionals that supports Sales across all regions and time zones.

 - Be a trusted advisor to Sales leadership on deal structure, pricing, discounting and negotiation strategy for complex, high-value consumption and multi-year agreements.

 - Coordinate cross-functional input from Sales, Legal, Revenue Accounting, Finance, Services, Operations, Product and Engineering to move deals from structure to signature efficiently.

 - Lead the AI transformation of the Deal Desk. Working with Data Analytics and Enterprise Technology, build an AI-native organization: deploy AI agents and copilots for deal structuring guidance, pricing recommendations, contract review and redlining, approval routing, and deal risk scoring.

 - Champion AI adoption across the team. Build AI fluency, redesign workflows around automation, and measure the impact on productivity, cycle time and deal quality.


OUR IDEAL SENIOR DIRECTOR, WW DEAL DESK WILL HAVE:

 - Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 - 15+ years of experience across deal desk, procurement, sales finance, commercial finance, pricing, contract negotiation or sales operations, including significant time leading global teams.

 - Deep experience structuring and negotiating complex enterprise contracts with long sales cycles.

 - Strong understanding of revenue recognition (ASC 606) and US GAAP.

 - Demonstrated AI proficiency: hands-on experience applying generative AI, LLM-based tools or automation to finance, sales operations or deal workflows, plus a clear view of where AI does and doesn't belong in governance-heavy processes.

 - Track record of designing and rolling out complex finance systems, processes and tools (for example CPQ, CLM, CRM).

 - Ability to break down complex issues and explain them clearly to everyone from frontline sellers to the C-suite.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation and executive stakeholder skills.

 - A builder's mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, high deal velocity and quarter-end pressure, and motivated by helping Sales win.


DESIRED SKILLS/EXPERTISE:

 - Track record of driving cross-functional alignment and managing strategic relationships across Sales, Legal and Finance.

 - Proven experience designing deal approval governance and commercial risk mitigation frameworks.

 - Strong leadership in hiring, coaching and developing talent across distributed global teams.

 - Experience leading AI or automation programs that delivered measurable gains in efficiency or quality.

jobs.title: Senior Deal Desk Analyst, APAC
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.



ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is building its first Deal Desk presence in APAC, and this is the first hire. You will be the commercial subject matter expert for our APAC go-to-market teams across Australia, Japan, Korea and the wider region. You will help AEs shape, price, negotiate and closedeals, and make sure those deals are captured accurately in our quote-to-cash systems.

This is a hybrid role covering deal strategy and deal operations. You will report to the Head of Deal Desk, who is based in the US, and work closely with APAC GTM leadership, RevOps, Pricing and Packaging, Legal, Finance and Product.




WHAT YOU’LL DO




DEAL STRATEGY

 - Partner with AEs at every deal stage on structure, pricing and negotiation, not just at contracting

 - Build scenario-based pricing models (usage projections, ARR impact, credit allotment sizing) and use product telemetry to connect customer usage to price and value

 - Act as the expert on Harvey’s move to consumption-based pricing, and help AEs explain it to law firm and in-house customers

 - Handle redlines and non-standard requests with Legal, Finance and Product;summarize and escalate approvals

 - Build and maintain field-facing playbooks covering what is allowed, fallback positions and approval paths

 - Deliver enablement to the APAC field on pricing and deal best practices

 - Join customer calls where you can add value

 - Track the commercial pulse of the region and proactively raise trends and insights to Deal Desk and GTM leadership


DEAL OPERATIONS

 - Review, validate and process orders for accuracy, policy compliance and booking readiness

 - Act as the first line of support for Salesforce and CPQ quoting, approvals and opportunity hygiene

 - Manage and triage the regional Deal Ops ticket queue

 - Contribute to CRM and CPQ enhancements through requirements, UAT and rollouts of new workflows or guardrails


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4+ years in Deal Desk, Commercial or Sales Operations, or RevOps supporting deal construction, with hands-on experience in both strategy and operations

 - Experience with consumption or usage-based pricing (big data, cloud infrastructure or AI platforms are a strong plus)

 - Pricing models and scenario analyses you built yourself and used in live deals

 - Experience with Salesforce and CPQ (e.g. Salesforce CPQ, DealHub) and quote-to-cash processes

 - Experience delivering field enablement and creating playbooks or process documentation

 - Clear, concise and measured communication with AEs, executives and cross-functional partners

 - Calm under pressure, and able to say no while staying a trusted business partner

 - Comfortable working autonomously with a manager in another time zone, and thriving through constant change

 - Uses AI tools to work more efficiently


WHY JOIN

 - You will be the first Deal Desk hire in APAC, joining early in Harvey’s regional growth

 - You will shape how Harvey prices and sells as it moves to consumption-based pricing

 - Strong, structured onboarding followed by real autonomy

 - A potential long-term path to leading Deal Desk in the region as the team grows


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 - Location: Sydney, NSW (Hybrid with flexibility)

 - Work eligibility: Must have valid Australian work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Structured hybrid working arrangement: 3 days in our Sydney office, 2 days working from home

 - Health Coverage: Fully covered private hospital insurance, plus extras for dental, optical, physio, mental health, and more.

 - Family & Fertility Support: Support for fertility treatments, adoption, and surrogacy through Carrot.

 - Retirement & Security: Comprehensive coverage designed to support your long-term well-being.
