The franchisee is a separate company and a separate employer from Marriott International, Inc. The franchisee solely controls all aspects of the hotel’s employment policies and practices, including hiring, firing, discipline, staffing, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment. If you accept a position at this hotel, you will be employed by a franchisee and not by Marriott International, Inc.

 Location: Atlanta or Tampa Metro Area

 Reports to: Vice President, Sales & Marketing

 Status: Exempt

 Mainsail Lodging is seeking an experienced, analytical, and commercially minded Cluster Director of Revenue Management to lead revenue strategy for three of Mainsail’s distinctive full-service lifestyle hotels: Epicurean Tampa, Epicurean Atlanta, and Luminary Hotel & Co. This position is responsible for maximizing revenue, profitability, RevPAR, market share, and overall commercial performance across the three-property portfolio.

 The Cluster Director of Revenue Management will develop and execute sophisticated revenue strategies across transient, group, negotiated, wholesale, and catering segments while optimizing room inventory, function space, pricing, distribution, and demand.

 The ideal candidate is a strategically minded commercial leader and business partner who can translate data into action, challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and influence Sales, Marketing, Operations, and General Management teams.

 Working closely with Mainsail’s corporate leadership, General Managers, Directors of Sales, and property teams, this role will help establish the optimal business mix, pricing strategy, forecasting approach, and sales priorities for each hotel.

 Because the three hotels operate in distinct markets and have different demand patterns, this position requires the ability to understand the individual identity and commercial opportunity of each property while developing strategies that maximize the performance of the portfolio.

 Essential Functions

 Revenue Strategy & Commercial Leadership

 •

 Develop and execute comprehensive revenue management strategies for Epicurean Tampa, Epicurean Atlanta, and Luminary Hotel & Co.

 •

 Maximize rooms' revenue, total hotel revenue, profitability, RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, and market share.

 Forecasting & Business Intelligence

 •

 Prepare accurate monthly and rolling revenue forecasts for each assigned hotel, with a target of maintaining forecast accuracy within 5%.

 •

 Analyze historical trends, current pace, booking windows, cancellations, no-shows, wash, displacement, market demand, and competitive performance.

 Group, Catering & Function Space Strategy

 •

 Partner closely with Sales and Catering leadership to optimize group rooms, meeting space, catering, and function-space revenue.

 •

 Evaluate group opportunities based on displacement, profitability, total spend, pattern, compression, and future demand.

 Inventory & Distribution Management

 •

 Manage room inventory to maximize revenue and optimize sell-out efficiency.

 Sales & Revenue Partnership

 •

 Work closely with Directors of Sales and Sales teams to align revenue strategy with sales activity.

 •

 Provide sales teams with market intelligence, demand forecasts, pricing guidance, and business opportunities.

 Marketing & Digital Performance

 •

 Partner with Marketing leadership to align promotional activity, digital campaigns, offers, and demand-generation strategies with revenue objectives.

 Leadership & Team Development

 •

 Lead with an energetic, collaborative, and solution-oriented approach.

 •

 Build strong relationships with General Managers, Sales Leaders, Operations teams, Finance partners, Corporate Leadership, hotel associates and Hotel Owners.

 Qualifications

 Education

 •

 Bachelor's degree in hospitality management, Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

 Experience

 •

 3–5 years of hotel Revenue Management experience required.

 •

 Multi-property or cluster Revenue Management experience strongly preferred.

 •

 Experience with full-service, lifestyle, luxury, boutique, or resort hotels preferred.

 •

 Experience managing both transient and group-oriented hotels preferred.

 •

 Experience with Marriott revenue-management practices and systems strongly preferred.

 Knowledge & Skills

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.



Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.



*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

Preferable to have someone near an office in NYC or San Francisco, but open to hiring around the world for the right candidate.



Runway Creative is an all-in-one platform giving creators and businesses endless ways to generate and edit video, images, and audio. Our customers range from individual creators on self-serve plans to studios and enterprise marketing teams, and they generate with both Runway's own models and leading third-party models, all on one platform.



We're hiring a Pricing & Packaging Lead to own how Runway creates and captures value across all of it. You'll partner closely with our Self-Serve Product Lead to evolve our plans and credits, build the path from self-serve to enterprise, and set the pricing for every model we launch and every third-party model we serve. You'll build the pricing framework the rest of the company uses, and you'll be accountable for revenue growth, gross margin, and customer trust in equal measure.

 - Own self-serve pricing & packaging: partner with the Self-Serve Product Lead on our plan ladder and credit design, including allowances, rollover, top-ups, annual vs. monthly, and regional pricing. Run a continuous program of pricing and packaging experiments with Growth and Data.

 - Keep pricing changes trustworthy: own how we communicate every pricing change, from advance notice and in-product usage visibility to spend controls and customer FAQs. Changes should land as clearly as they were designed.

 - Build the team: hire and lead a small pricing team over time, and partner closely with billing engineering to turn decisions into systems.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 10+ years across pricing, monetization, strategy, or strategic finance, with 5+ years directly owning pricing and packaging decisions. A track record of moving revenue, conversion, and margin, not just producing recommendations.

 - Deep experience with usage, credit, or consumption-based pricing. You can build a cost-to-serve and margin model from compute and inference inputs, and you understand how hybrid seat + usage models behave in the wild.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

 Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

 To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

 Fever's data team is actively engaged in building and running end-to-end systems that manage and optimise prices across the platform: defining price structures, setting initial prices, running adaptive pricing control loops, assigning tiers with AI, and providing the tooling commercial teams use to request and understand price changes. The engine is live and evolving, and thousands of pricing decisions run through it every day, across everything we sell, owned and partner-operated alike.

 The foundation is built; the opportunity is what we build on top of it: Fever intends to be the leading platform for pricing concerts, exhibitions, live sports, game centres, theme parks and whatever comes next.

 This is a builder role rather than an advisory one. You will decide which pricing approaches travel across sectors and which have to be built from scratch, which capabilities are simply table stakes we need to get right, and where we can go further than anyone else has. Your expertise sets the direction and picks the building blocks we are going to use; the team turns them into the models, experiments, and optimisation that run at scale.

 Few pricing roles span this much variety. A concert, a museum, a theme park and a football match each come with their own economics, their own objectives, and their own constraints.  Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

 The Director, Revenue Management - Upscale Brands plays a pivotal role in overseeing and optimizing revenue-related functions across the Upscale segment and ChoiceROCS Program. Provide training and guidance to the two direct-report Regional Managers and their teams of Revenue Managers to enhance their skills and capabilities in revenue management practices.
• Change Management: Develop effective and appropriate change interventions and deliverables in conjunction with the segment and program team, including communication plans, training and engagement materials, resource and training needs analysis.

Monitor the portfolio and identify gaps in achieving targets and Commercial Plan goals, creating action plans to support eliminating the gaps.

jobs.description:
Staples Digital Solutions is building scalable AI-powered pricing, forecasting, optimization, and decision intelligence capabilities that help improve revenue, margin performance, customer value, and operational efficiency. This team partners across Product, Finance, Merchandising, Revenue Management, Digital, Sales, and Technology to turn complex commercial challenges into practical, measurable business outcomes.

 As the Sr. Manager Data Science & Engineering-Pricing & Optimization you will lead the strategy, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade AI solutions that power smarter pricing and decision-making. You’ll manage AI Engineering and Data Engineering teams, guide technical roadmaps, and work closely with business and technology leaders to deliver solutions that drive growth, improve profitability, and create a better experience for customers and associates.

 While this role will need to work our 4 day/week on-site hybrid schedule out of the Framingham, MA HQ facility, we will consider candidates willing to relocate and are able to consider providing relocation assistance.

 What you’ll be doing:

 • Lead the roadmap and delivery for pricing AI, forecasting, optimization, and decision intelligence solutions.
• Oversee development of capabilities such as price elasticity modeling, demand forecasting, promotion optimization, revenue optimization, and competitive pricing.
• Apply machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, and optimization techniques to solve complex business problems.

• Establish performance metrics, monitor business impact, and drive continuous improvement of AI solutions.
• Partner with Product, Finance, Merchandising, Revenue Management, Digital, Sales, and Technology teams to prioritize work and deliver measurable business value.
• Champion AI-assisted software development practices that improve delivery speed, quality, and productivity.
• Manage team resources, budgets, priorities, and execution across multiple high-impact workstreams.
• Lead, coach, recruit, retain, and develop AI Engineering and Data Engineering talent while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

 What you bring to the table:

 • Strategic and technical leadership with the ability to connect AI engineering work to business goals.
• Strong commercial judgment and the ability to understand pricing, revenue, margin, and customer-value drivers.
• Analytical problem-solving skills and curiosity for using data to improve decision quality.
• Clear communication skills, including the ability to translate complex AI, analytics, and engineering concepts into business-focused recommendations.
• Cross-functional collaboration and influence across product, business, finance, sales, digital, and technology stakeholders.
• A people-first leadership style focused on coaching, talent development, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• An innovation mindset and comfort leading change in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Strong prioritization skills with the ability to balance multiple initiatives, risks, resources, and outcomes.

 What’s needed- Basic Qualifications:

 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, or related technical or quantitative field, or equivalent work experience.
• 10+ years of experience delivering enterprise-scale AI, data, analytics, or software engineering solutions.
• 5+ years of experience leading technical, analytics, AI, data engineering, or software engineering teams.
• 3+ years of experience supporting pricing, revenue management, forecasting, optimization, or retail analytics solutions.
• Experience developing, deploying, or supporting production AI/ML solutions.
• Experience using Python and SQL in AI, machine learning, data engineering, analytics, or software engineering environments.
• Experience working with cloud-based data, AI, or engineering platforms.
• Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions with measurable outcomes.

 What’s needed- Preferred Qualifications:

 • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative, analytics, or technology discipline.
• Experience with price elasticity modeling, promotion optimization, demand forecasting, revenue optimization, or competitive pricing capabilities.
• Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Azure AI, MLOps, or cloud-native architectures.
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar technologies.

 We Offer:

jobs.title: Cluster Reservations and Revenue Optimization Manager
jobs.description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Cluster Reservations and Revenue Optimization Manager , you’re not just driving profitability through strategic pricing and inventory – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

 Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

 Revenue and Commercial Performance

 • Work alongside RMCC and the Cluster Commercial Director on forecasts, budgets, demand calendars, pricing recommendations and commercial action plans for each hotel.
• Monitor occupancy, average daily rate, RevPAR, pickup, booking pace, cancellations, no-shows, channel mix, and competitor activity; flag risks and opportunities promptly.
• Support rate and inventory strategies by room type, segment, length of stay, booking window, and distribution channel within approved authority.
• Analyze group and corporate inquiries, displacement, special events, and need periods; recommend commercially sound decisions.
• Review performance of direct, brand, online travel agency, wholesale, and other channels; identify opportunities to improve net revenue and reduce distribution cost.

 Reservations Operations

• Oversee accurate and timely handling of individual, group, and special reservation requests by phone, email, and approved systems.
• Maintain correct rates, packages, restrictions, allotments, room descriptions, policies, and inventory across the property management system, central reservation system, and connected channels.
• Ensure deposits, guarantees, modifications, cancellations, billing instructions, and guest preferences are captured and communicated accurately.
• Coordinate with Front Office, Sales, Events, Finance, and other departments to manage arrivals, overbookings, room blocks, VIP needs, and service recovery.
• Monitor response time, call quality, booking conversion, data accuracy, and unresolved guest or partner cases; implement improvements.

 Controls and Reporting

• Produce reliable daily, weekly, and monthly reservation and revenue reports, with clear explanations of material variances.
• Maintain rate integrity, approved access rights, audit trails, payment data handling, and compliance with Hilton standards, property procedures, and applicable privacy requirements.
• Check system interfaces and booking flows; coordinate resolution of mapping, parity, availability, and connectivity issues with relevant teams.
• Document procedures, train colleagues on system changes, and support contingency plans during outages or peak demand.

 People Leadership

• Plan staffing and schedules across the cluster according to demand and service requirements.

• Coach team members on selling skills, product knowledge, reservations accuracy, guest communication, and performance standards.

• Set measurable objectives, review performance regularly, address gaps fairly, and support succession and development.

 What It Takes to Make the Stay

 At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

 Additionally, the below are the requirement for the position:

 • Commercial judgment; attention to detail; guest focus; problem solving; clear communication; coaching; collaboration; discretion with confidential information; ability to prioritize under pressure.
• Reservations conversion and response time; forecast accuracy; rate and inventory accuracy; channel and segment performance; contribution to occupancy, ADR and RevPAR goals; guest and partner feedback; audit compliance; team development and retention. Targets are set through the annual business plan and individual objectives.
• Bachelor’s degree or diploma in hospitality, business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Experience in hotel reservations and revenue management, including team supervision and multi-property coordination.
• Working knowledge of hotel property management, central reservation, revenue management, channel management, and reporting systems.
• Strong Excel and analytical skills, with the ability to explain commercial trends and translate findings into actions.
• Excellent written and spoken English; Arabic is an advantage.

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

 A Day in the Life
We are excited to offer an excellent opportunity for a pricing professional who is passionate about driving business performance through pricing operations, governance, analytics, and process excellence. This role provides the opportunity to support critical pricing initiatives, contribute to margin optimization efforts, strengthen pricing compliance, and collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Finance, Customer Care, Operations, and Deal Desk functions. It is an ideal opportunity for someone looking to broaden their experience in pricing operations, deal management, automation, and AI-enabled analytical solutions.

The position is part of a highly collaborative regional pricing organization and offers exposure to stakeholders across multiple countries and business functions. The role involves managing day-to-day pricing operations within systems such as Vendavo, SAP, and ServiceNow, supporting deal creation and maintaining pricing agreements and master data, and performing pricing, margin, and profitability analyses. The successful candidate will work closely with Commercial teams and Deal Desk partners to ensure accurate and timely pricing execution while supporting pricing governance and compliance requirements.

In addition, the role offers the opportunity to contribute to projects involving automation, artificial intelligence (AI), advanced analytics, and dashboard development. The successful candidate will help develop data-driven reporting and analytical solutions that improve pricing accuracy, enhance operational efficiency, support decision-making, identify margin improvement opportunities, and strengthen pricing governance through intelligent automation and actionable business insights.

 Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

 • Develop and maintain dashboards, automated reports, analytical tools, and data visualizations that provide insights into pricing performance, margin realization, business trends, and operational efficiency
• Support automation, AI-enabled analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline processes, improve reporting capabilities, and enhance decision-making through data-driven solutions
• Create, review, maintain, and monitor customer pricing agreements, contracts, quotations, and pricing deals within systems such as Vendavo and SAP

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, GTM Strategy & Sales Packaging
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 Lyft Ads gives brands a unique way to reach consumers during high-intent moments: on their way to concerts, games, nights out, and everyday destinations. In this role, you'll set the strategy behind how we bring those moments to market, arm our sellers to win, and connect advertisers with millions of riders across the country.

 Lyft Ads is looking for a Senior Manager of Sales Packaging & Go-to-Market Strategy to build and lead the function that turns ridership data, cultural moments, and product capabilities into the packages our sales team sells every day. This is a strategic leadership role: you'll set the packaging and pricing agenda for the full Lyft Ads portfolio, build the go-to-market motions behind our biggest revenue moments, and give sellers the stories, structure, and pricing tools they need to win.

 You are a builder. You operate comfortably at the intersection of strategy and execution, and you have a track record of driving commercial outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. You bring a POV to partnership and packaging conversations, and you know how to align internal and external stakeholders around a shared vision. You are energized by the challenge of taking a scaled, high-growth advertising business and making it even better: more differentiated, more efficient, and more impactful for the brands and agencies that invest with Lyft Ads.

 You'll operate at the intersection of data, product, pricing, creative, and sales, and you'll be expected to bring an independent point of view on where Lyft Ads should show up, what we should charge, and how we package multi-product solutions with measurement built in. This role owns and manages the Lyft Ads Studio team, sits at the table with Sales leadership, and works in close partnership with Data Science, Finance, Product Marketing, Product, and cross-functional leadership across the business.

 Responsibilities:

• Own the sales packaging strategy for Lyft Ads' full suite of on- and off-platform advertising solutions, building differentiated packages that map to advertiser objectives and buying behavior

• Set the vision and calendar for tentpole and cultural-moment packaging (Super Bowl, March Madness, Women’s World Cup, Coachella, Formula 1, SXSW, Halloween, Valentine's Day, New Year's Eve), using ridership and audience data to identify where and when advertisers should show up

• Craft the go-to-market narratives behind each package, from initial data-driven thesis to the story sellers use in market, in partnership with Product Marketing and Lyft Ads Studio

• Formulate pricing and deal economics for sponsorships, tentpole packages, and multi-product bundles, balancing revenue optimization with competitive positioning and advertiser value

• Build multi-product solutions that combine packaging with measurement frameworks, giving advertisers a clear read on performance and giving sellers proof points to close

• Partner with Sales, Data Science, and Finance to model package performance, set pricing guardrails, and build scalable frameworks for both direct IO and programmatic deal structures

• Develop audience-segmented packaging for key verticals (CPG, QSR, Auto, Financial Services, Travel) to sharpen sales conversations by category

• Own the GTM materials that arm the field: one-sheets, rate cards, media plans, packaging guides, and sales playbooks

• Establish a feedback loop between field sales and the packaging/pricing function so offerings stay relevant, competitive, and commercially viable

• Report on tentpole and package performance and build case studies with Product Marketing to prove out the model and inform the next cycle

• Represent packaging strategy in front of Sales and Ads leadership, and act as a thought partner to the VP on where the portfolio should go next

• Lead and manage the Lyft Ads Studio team, currently two creative strategists, a designer, and a program manager, setting priorities, workflow, and quality bar for the creative and GTM work that supports every package

• Hold a seat at the table with Sales leadership, representing packaging, pricing, and creative strategy in planning and pipeline conversations

• Build and maintain close working relationships with cross-functional leaders across Product, Data Science, Finance, and Marketing to keep packaging strategy aligned to the broader business

 Experience:

• 15+ years of experience in digital advertising, with meaningful depth in brand media solutions, programmatic, ad tech, and/or commerce/retail media

• In-depth understanding of building brand solutions across on-platform, programmatic, and experiential

• Strong knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem, including DSPs (e.g., The Trade Desk, DV360, Amazon DSP), SSPs, DMPs, CDPs, clean rooms, and measurement partners

jobs.title: Pricing Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Pricing & Monetization team is responsible for how our products create and capture value. We partner closely with Product, GTM, Finance, and Systems teams to design pricing models, packaging, and commercial strategies that support adoption, growth, and long-term scaling of the business.

To thrive in this team, you need to be a proactive problem-solver who excels at bringing structure to ambiguous challenges. Our work demands strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and precision in execution. Team members succeed when they are analytical, detail-oriented, skilled at balancing multiple priorities, and passionate about driving high-stakes projects forward to deliver meaningful results.

About the Role

We are looking for a Pricing Operations Lead to help translate pricing and packaging decisions into clear, scalable execution. You will work closely with pricing leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Billing, Finance, and GTM to ensure pricing changes are implemented accurately, system requirements are well managed, and launch decisions move from strategy to reality with discipline.

You should be comfortable operating at the intersection of business judgment, systems thinking, and program management. This role will help shape the operating backbone for pricing implementation, support teams developing billing and related monetization systems, and ensure the pricing team's needs are represented clearly in cross-functional planning and execution.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead the operational execution of pricing and packaging decisions from approval through implementation and launch

 - Translate pricing strategy, policies, and launch decisions into clear business requirements for billing, quoting, revenue, and related systems teams

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Billing, Finance, and GTM teams to manage dependencies, scope tradeoffs, testing needs, and launch readiness

 - Own pricing-related requirement intake and prioritization on behalf of the pricing team, ensuring requests are clear, well managed, and tied to business needs

 - Support the design and implementation of new product, SKU, packaging, and billing configurations as pricing changes move into production

 - Establish lightweight but effective pricing operations processes, including governance, documentation, sign-offs, and issue tracking

 - Identify recurring friction in pricing execution and drive improvements that reduce ambiguity, delays, and rework

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 6+ years of experience leading pricing operations or closely related monetization, commercialization, or revenue operations work

 - Have a strong track record of helping implement complex pricing or packaging decisions across cross-functional teams

 - Can translate pricing intent into practical system requirements, launch plans, operating workflows, and stakeholder decisions

 - Have experience partnering closely with billing systems, product, engineering, finance, and go-to-market teams

 - Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, risks, and timelines at once

 - Communicate clearly with both business and technical audiences, and can drive accountability without creating unnecessary process

 - Care deeply about operational precision, customer clarity, and building systems that scale as pricing complexity grows

 - Are a self-starter who can roll up your sleeves and operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Algorithms - Dynamic Pricing
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 The Marketplace team at Lyft is responsible for accelerating the growth of the business while simultaneously delivering on key business and financial metrics, and Dynamic Pricing & Offer Selection is an integral part of that. Our team is the dynamic pricing team responsible for leveraging both real-time and historical data to set prices for every single ride at Lyft while balancing prices and ETAs to better serve our riders’ needs.

 We are looking for fast learning, data-driven individuals who are passionate about tackling these open-ended problems in pricing theory and making a large, positive impact in the business. In this role, you will work closely with Product and Engineering on a cross-functional team to prototype and build end-to-end dynamic pricing models that can operate at scale. In addition, you will be expected to leverage your domain knowledge and influence existing and future roadmaps to help Lyft continue to deliver a better experience for riders and drivers.

 Responsibilities:

• Partner with other scientists, colleagues in the pricing team, and with external teams to formalize problems mathematically and within the business context

• Perform complex data analysis to gain a deeper understanding of problems by identifying their root causes

• Develop and fit statistical, machine learning, or optimization models

• Write production code; collaborate with Software Engineers to ship models to production

• Design and implement both simulated and live experiments

• Analyze experimental and observational data; facilitate launch decisions

• Communicate findings to a broad audience consisting of Product, Engineering, and executive leadership

 Experience:

• Data Scientist with experience in Machine Learning, Statistics, Economics, or other quantitative fields

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or other quantitative fields

• 1-4+ years of professional experience for PhDs or 3-5+ years for Master’s in a Data Science role

• Passion for solving unstructured and non-standard mathematical problems

• End-to-end experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization

• Proficiency with Python, or another interpreted programming language like R or Matlab

• Proficiency in SQL - able to write structured and efficient queries involving multiple large data sets

• Ability to collaborate and communicate with others to solve a problem

• Strong oral and written communication skills, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners

• Experience in causal inference, LTV modeling, econometrics, or user choice modeling preferred

 Benefits:

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Child care and pet benefits

• 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

• In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

• 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

 Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

 Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

 The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $128,000 - $160,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Credit & Pricing
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 About the Product Team

 The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

 As a Staff Product Manager on Affirm’s Credit & Pricing team, you’ll shape how consumers discover, understand, and use available credit. You’ll own the strategy for credit experiences spanning shopping, repayment, and marketing, turning complex credit capabilities into intuitive products that build trust and drive activation, conversion, and repeat engagement.

 What You'll Do

• Set the product direction. Define a cohesive vision for consumer credit experiences, identify the most valuable problems to solve, and translate your strategy into priorities across multiple teams.

• Build experiences that make credit understandable. Help consumers explore potential financing options before checkout, discover where they have purchasing power, and understand when credit becomes available again after repayment.

• Create more relevant consumer journeys. Develop personalized experiences for new and returning consumers, using research and experimentation to determine what information, guidance, and next steps best meet their needs.

• Connect platform capabilities to consumer outcomes. Own merchant prequalification and purchasing power experiences, partnering with core purchasing power and credit decisioning teams to translate underlying capabilities into clear, consistent experiences.

• Lead consequential product decisions. Bring Engineering, Design, Analytics, Credit, Marketing, Commercial, and Legal partners together to resolve tradeoffs across consumer needs, growth, risk, and partner commitments. Influence senior leaders through clear recommendations and sound judgment.

• Own measurable results. Define success, lead discovery and experimentation, and use funnel analysis and consumer feedback to improve activation, purchase conversion, repeat engagement, and comprehension while supporting responsible access to credit.

 What We Look For

• A record of building impactful consumer products. 7+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated success taking products from discovery through launch and scaling adoption in fintech, e-commerce, marketplaces, or similarly complex environments.

• Leadership across teams. Experience independently setting direction for a substantial product area, influencing senior stakeholders, and aligning multiple teams around priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Strong consumer product judgment. An ability to translate complex systems into intuitive experiences, with a high bar for interaction design, clear communication, and consumer trust.

• Strategic and technical depth. You connect long-term opportunities to practical product and platform decisions, and work effectively with engineers on capabilities that serve multiple experiences.

• Analytical and experimental rigor. You combine customer research, behavioral data, and well-designed experiments to prioritize opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, and decide what to scale, change, or stop.

• Ownership in ambiguity. You bring structure to open-ended problems, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and communicate the rationale, risks, and support needed to move forward.

• Relevant domain curiosity. Experience with credit, lending, personalization, or AI-powered consumer experiences is a plus. You can learn complex domains quickly and distinguish useful innovation from technology without a clear customer need.

 Pay Grade - P
 Equity Grade - 7

 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $181,000 - $241,000

 This posting is for an existing vacancy.

 Location - Remote Canada
 This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Pricing & Revenue
jobs.description:
About the company

 At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

 By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

 With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

 Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from Booking.com , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

 Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

 About the job

 Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or London.

 This is a product role where a good idea in the morning can be in the product by the evening.

 You’ll own Pricing & Revenue: the layer that decides which hotel supply we distribute, at what price, and with what margin across hundreds of supplier connections.

 You’ll run it as a full business and product domain. You’re accountable for the outcomes, economics, priorities, and product decisions. You’ll help define what success looks like, then decide with your team what to prioritise, what to test, what to build, and where to make trade-offs.

 The problem underneath is unusually complex. A single hotel search can trigger synchronous queries across around 200 suppliers. How do you choose the right supply, price it competitively, and improve margin when distribution and connectivity are happening in real time?

 What makes it interesting for you

• You can move extremely fast. There’s very little red tape, teams make their own product decisions, and the culture is much closer to ask for forgiveness than wait for permission. If something makes sense, you can test it quickly instead of spending weeks getting alignment.

• You own the path to the outcome. You’ll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there.

• You get a genuinely hard marketplace problem. Pricing, distribution, supply, connectivity, and monetisation all interact in real time.

• You’ll help build Nuitee’s product organisation. We got to roughly €1B in booking value without a proper product org. Now we’re building one, and you’ll help shape it as we push toward €10B.

 Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build.

 The kind of problems you’ll work on

• How do we choose the best supply across hundreds of supplier connections for each search?

• How should pricing and margin change across customers, suppliers, markets, and booking contexts to grow take rate and revenue while staying competitive?

• How do we separate distribution decisions from the technical constraints of querying suppliers synchronously?

 This role fits if you

• Have owned a product or business area end to end for several years and can show the outcomes you drove.

• Understand marketplace or distribution economics, especially pricing, supply, demand, margin, monetisation, or incentives.

• Can go deep into data and commercial mechanics and turn that into product decisions.

• Are comfortable working closely with engineering on technically complex products.

• Have worked in a high-pressure environment where you were expected to drive the outcome yourself.

• Are willing to go deep into trading, pricing, and revenue optimisation rather than staying at surface-level product management.

 Marketplace or distribution depth matters more to us than travel experience.

 Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your product actually delivers.

 If this sounds like your kind of product role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks.

 Why Nuitee?

 At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
About Us

 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

 About the Deal Desk Team

 The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.

 Available Location: Singapore

 Role Summary

 As a Deal Desk Manager, you will be the architect of our AI-driven deal desk, transitioning our sales process from manual workflows to an intelligent, automated engine that spans from initial scoping to final execution. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. The objective is to serve as a high-influence "Sales Co-pilot," using AI-driven insights to maximize deal velocity and Long-Term Value (LTV) while relentlessly reducing friction through iterative process automation.

 What you’ll do

• Orchestrate Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead the structuring and execution of non-standard, high-value enterprise deals, providing high-judgment guidance that balances competitive differentiation with long-term business health. Build creative financial models and custom discount strategies that align customer usage patterns with corporate revenue goals.

• Sales Co-pilot & Strategic Influence: Serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership, utilizing data driven insights and workflows to maximize deal velocity, improve LTV, and ensure discovery reflects true customer needs. Perform analysis on pricing and deal terms, leveraging AI insights to recommend "next best action" for deal structuring and margin optimization. Drive consensus across internal stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Revenue Recognition, Compliance and Product) to negotiate viable compromises on non-standard commercial, financial, and legal terms while safeguarding corporate margin thresholds and risk tolerance.

• Champion AI, Curate and Tune AI Agents for Automation Integration: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale. Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Identify bottlenecks and implement AI-powered productivity solutions.

• Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.

 Role Specifications & Qualifications

• Minimum 8+ years of Deal Desk, FP&A, Revenue Operations, or similar experience with a proven track record supporting large-scale enterprise sales motions; 3+ years of direct deal desk experience (deal analysis, deal governance and customer negotiation) preferred

• Financial & Sales Acumen: Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, pricing models, and financial concepts like ARR, Gross Margin, churn, and profitability. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus

jobs.description:
Business Director-Strategic Pricing

 As a Business Director at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You’ll team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line.  An overview of this role

 Credit-based and consumption-based offerings are becoming central to how GitLab monetizes. The systems that meter, rate, and bill that consumption sit underneath all of it. You'll own the backend usage billing pipeline and its product direction while supporting the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team as it modernizes the foundations underneath it.

The position collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, and business leadership to align pricing decisions with organizational objectives, enhance pricing processes, and improve customer value.

 Key Responsibilities

 • Lead the development, implementation, and execution of pricing strategies that support business growth, profitability, and competitive positioning.

 • Plan, analyze, obtain approvals for, and execute annual and mid-year pricing revisions across multiple product lines and market segments.

 • Maintain accurate pricing data across ERP, CRM, order management, rebate, and pricing systems, ensuring data integrity and first-time accuracy.

 • Manage multiple pricing structures and price lists while ensuring synchronization across enterprise systems.

 • Prepare customer quotations and pricing proposals in collaboration with Sales teams and support complex customer pricing negotiations.

 • Analyze pricing performance, market trends, customer behavior, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data to recommend pricing improvements and business actions.

 • Lead pricing governance forums and facilitate collaborative pricing decisions with Sales, Finance, and business leadership.

 • Design and continuously improve pricing methodologies, pricing policies, and pricing philosophies aligned with business objectives.

 • Lead pricing analytics initiatives by leveraging business intelligence, automation, AI, and digital tools to improve pricing effectiveness and decision-making.

 • Develop reports, dashboards, forecasts, and executive presentations that provide meaningful pricing insights and business recommendations.

 • Lead pricing improvement projects, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to enhance operational efficiency.

 • Ensure timely resolution of complex pricing issues while providing excellent support to internal and external customers.

 • Maintain confidentiality of pricing information and ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, and applicable regulations.

 • Monitor pricing operational KPIs including turnaround time, accuracy, and service levels, implementing corrective actions where required.

 • Coach, mentor, and develop pricing team members while fostering a collaborative, high-performance work environment.

 Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, Supply Chain, and other business functions to achieve shared business goals.

 Core Competencies

 • Pricing Strategy & Execution
• Pricing Analytics & Business Intelligence
• Market Analysis & Forecasting
• Financial & Commercial Acumen
• Customer Pricing & Quotation Management
• Data Analysis & Decision Making
• Cross-functional Collaboration
• Stakeholder Management & Influencing
• Project Leadership & Continuous Improvement
• ERP, CRM & Pricing Systems Management
• AI & Digital Analytics Adoption
• Problem Solving & Critical Thinking
• Process Excellence
• Customer Focus
• Effective Communication
• Accountability & Ownership
• Managing Ambiguity
• Building Networks
• Collaboration

• Valuing Diverse Perspectives

 Qualifications

• Master's degree or relevant professional certifications in Pricing, Finance, Analytics, or Business Management are preferred.

 Skills & Experience

jobs.description:
Career Category
Sales & Marketing Operations
 Job Description

 Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

 Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

 Contracts & Pricing Strategy, Associate Director

 What you will do

 The Contracts & Pricing Strategy Associate Director leads integrated U.S. pricing and contracting economics for OaR across launch and lifecycle planning. Reporting to the Dir Contracts & Pricing Strategy, the role translates the overall Obesity and Related Conditions contracts, pricing and value strategy into payer and Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBM) recommendations, Gross to Net (GTN) and latest estimate discount rate (LEDR) process, and coordinated channel economics. The role partners with the Consumer Director and Employer Lead Director to incorporate approved assumptions while they retain channel strategy and relationships. Prior-authorization and utilization-management analysis remain with the Coverage Lead.

 Core responsibilities:

 Pricing and contracting strategy:

 • Lead development of U.S. pricing and contracting recommendations for MariTide across commercial, Medicare and Medicaid channels across all payers and pharmacy benefit managers (PBM)
• Build account and portfolio economics, bid and negotiation scenarios, access-price trade-offs and guardrails.
• Partner with Coverage, Market Access, Contract Development and Contracting and Pricing Execution to translate approved strategy into executable contract terms.

 Integrated GTN and business planning:

 • Lead the Obesity latest estimate discount rate (LEDR) process and maintain the integrated gross to net (GTN) and net-sales view used in launch planning, quarterly business reviews and long-range planning.
• Reconcile rebates, fees, affordability, trade, government and channel-mix assumptions; run base, upside and downside scenarios; document key dependencies; and explain actual-to-plan variances and changes in forward assumptions.

 Consumer and employer economics:

 • Partner with the Consumer Director and Employer Lead Director to incorporate approved retail-pharmacy, cash-reimbursement and Direct to Employer (DTE) assumptions into gross to net (GTN).
• Model patient contribution, pharmacy and fulfillment fees, employer and member contributions, program fees, eligible lives, sites, enrollment, activation, utilization, persistence and ramp.
• Govern membership inputs and reconcile patient migration and population overlap across channels.

 Launch and lifecycle pricing:

 • Translate Global value and pricing considerations into U.S. launch scenarios and communicate U.S. channel implications to Global partners.
• Develop assumptions, analogs, sensitivity ranges and decision triggers where actuals do not exist.
• Extend the pricing and gross to net (GTN) architecture to future indications and sequencing decisions as populations, evidence, benefit management, utilization and channel mix evolve.

 Governance and cross-functional leadership:

 • Lead cross-functional pricing workstreams with Finance, Forecasting, Accounting, Government Pricing, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Trade, Brand and Market Access.
• Establish common model definitions, documentation and review cadence; identify duplicate-discount, classification, reporting, privacy and channel-conflict risks; and present clear recommendations, alternatives and unresolved issues to the Director and senior governance.

 What we expect of you

 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is someone with these qualifications.

 Basic qualifications:

 • Doctorate degree and 3 years of pricing, contracting, market access, finance, accounting, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
• Master’s degree and 5 years of pricing, contracting, market access, finance, accounting, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
• Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of pricing, contracting,

jobs.title: Pricing & Order Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us

 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on both companies' strengths while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 About the Role

 Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

 We’re looking for a Pricing & Order Operations Analyst to join our Order Operations & Monetization team. This role restores dedicated capacity for pricing and order operations testing, quote-to-cash (QTC) release validation, and order execution support.

 You’ll help ensure system changes are tested, validated, and operationally ready before they go live. You’ll provide Pricing and Order Operations subject-matter expertise and execute assigned business validation across signature packets, bookings, marketplace offers, and booking-to-order management handoffs. This role partners closely with Order Operations & Monetization, IT’s business systems team, Pricing Operations, Sales, and Deal Desk.

 Reporting & Prioritization

• Reports to the Order Operations & Monetization lead, Jamie Calkins.

• The Senior Pricing Operations Manager may help prioritize pricing-related test cases and QTC issues tied specifically to pricing and quoting.

• The Order Operations & Monetization lead owns final prioritization of the analyst’s workload across order operations, assigned non-pricing UAT participation, and pricing-related support work .

 This is a hybrid role, 1-2 days in the office.

 Technologies You’ll Use

• Salesforce CPQ

• Jira

• Suger and marketplace user interfaces, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Snowflake

• Notion

• Metronome

• Hex

 What You’ll Do

 Pricing Operations & QTC Support

• Support pricing operations changes through business requirement review, data validation, configuration checks, and documentation, helping ensure pricing logic is accurately reflected in QTC workflows.

• Validate pricing-related QTC changes across quoting, approvals, discounting logic, product configuration, and downstream order execution.

• Help confirm that pricing changes are operationally ready before launch, including impacts to Sales, Deal Desk, Order Operations, Billing, Revenue, and marketplace workflows.

• Partner with the Senior Pricing Operations Manager to prioritize pricing-related test cases, identify gaps in business requirements, and document expected system behavior.

• Help maintain documentation for pricing- and order-related system configurations, known dependencies, and release-readiness criteria.

 UAT & Testing

• Participate as a Pricing and Order Operations subject-matter expert in UAT project-managed by Technical Program Management (TPM) and executed under RevOps coordination, ensuring relevant business scenarios and expected outcomes are represented.

• Execute assigned Pricing and Order Operations test cases and collaborate with the GTM subject-matter experts identified by RevOps.

• Partner with RevOps and relevant subject-matter experts to develop and maintain Pricing and Order Operations test cases, including scenarios for quoting, approvals, signature packets, bookings, marketplace offers, billing, and order management.

• Document test results and defects with clear traceability from business requirement to test outcome, and provide domain-specific readiness input through the established UAT sign-off process.

• Maintain the Pricing and Order Operations portion of the regression test suite for recurring QTC changes.

 Order Operations

jobs.title: Pricing Operations Principal
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The Global Pricing Operations Team

 The Pricing Operations team works in a cross-functional, fast-paced, and dynamic environment with many moving pieces and evolving business needs. The team partners with Pricing Strategy Managers, Product Managers, Technology, Data & Intelligence, and various GTM teams to ensure Okta is operationally ready to bring new product pricing, buying programs, and strategic monetization initiatives to market.

 The Pricing Operations Principal Opportunity

 Okta is seeking a Pricing Operations Principal to lead initiatives that transform Okta's pricing strategy into successful go-to-market execution. A successful person in this role will be a strong collaborator, intensely curious, and supremely organized. They are known for connecting the dots, simplifying complexities, communicating clearly and proactively, and driving highly collaborative efforts to completion, even when the path forward isn't perfectly defined.

 In this role, you will serve as an operational leader for new pricing launches and a strategic buying-program implementation, establishing the integrated roadmap, operating cadence, decision-making framework, readiness criteria, and stakeholder communications required to bring these initiatives from concept through launch and sustained adoption. You will partner closely with senior cross-functional leaders to make complex tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and ensure the business is ready to sell, quote, contract, provision, bill, recognize revenue, support, and renew under the new model.

 As Okta rapidly launches new innovations and expands into new markets, this role is critical to our success.

 What you’ll be doing

• Drive cross-functional initiatives to transform pricing strategy into successful go-to-market execution

• Lead the operational implementation of buying programs that will affect how Okta packages, sells, measures, and supports its offerings, driving cross-functional alignment from design through launch and adoption.

• Collaborate closely with several functions across the company, including Pricing Strategy, Product, Product Marketing, Legal, Finance, GTM, and Technology, Data & Intelligence, to evaluate the operational impact of pricing initiatives, develop operational readiness plans, and execute launches

• Navigate ambiguity and fast-moving strategy decisions with confidence, helping the team align quickly and move forward effectively

• Continuously assess and re-prioritize workstreams as business needs evolve, maintaining clarity and momentum across multiple concurrent initiatives

• Drive strategic projects that use AI and other technology tools to optimize and automate pricing processes, strengthen operational standards, and improve cross-functional engagement frameworks.

• Develop business requirements for Technology, Data & Intelligence to build new SKUs in Okta's business systems to support quoting, invoicing, revenue recognition, reporting, and improved transaction processes for Okta's sales teams

• Proactively synthesize and communicate status updates, risks, and blockers to leaders and cross-functional stakeholders for pricing launches — not just when asked, but as a consistent habit

• Partner with GTM teams to assess enablement needs and develop, deliver, and optimize pricing enablement, training, and field communications for new launches, strategic initiatives, and ongoing pricing changes.

• Serve as SME on pricing, product configuration, and go-to-market processes

• Actively contribute to team culture by seeking and incorporating feedback, sharing learnings, and helping raise the bar for how the Pricing Operations function operates

 What you'll bring to the role

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy and emerging technology — supporting the pricing, margin analysis, and packaging work that shapes how Squarespace monetizes AI-powered features for customers and manages AI costs internally.

Solutions are delivered in whatever format best fits the need, often as always-on web applications (e.g., Python Dash apps), but also as ad-hoc analyses, or dashboards when appropriate.  • Assessing portfolio risk and opportunity at the portfolio or nameplate level
• Assessing business impacts of different incentive tactics to support incentive planning

• Supporting new model year launches, mid-year repricing, and short-term variable marketing adjustments

 What you'll do...

 Model Enhancement, Expansion & Maintenance

 • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of complex predictive models and optimization frameworks, driving scheduled updates, continuous improvement, and maintenance using advanced statistical and machine learning methodologies
• Serve as subject matter expert for our analytical products, ensuring the accuracy of underlying data, calculation logic, and business assumptions
• Drive the transition of analytical frameworks into production-ready assets, focusing on deployment automation, operational stability, and delivering clean, modular, well-documented code
• Explore opportunities to apply emerging techniques, such as agentic AI or LLM-based tools, to improve modeling workflows or analytical delivery

 • Partner directly with business stakeholders to understand evolving needs and convert ambiguous business problems into well-defined analytical problems

• Partner closely with data engineering, AI/ML engineering, and other analytics product teams within Yield Management to align data science capabilities with evolving business needs

 You'll have...

 • Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics/Econometrics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field
• 3+ years of experience in data analytics, AI/ML modeling, or related quantitative analysis
• Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Python, R, MATLAB, C/C++/C#, SAS), along with familiarity in ML/DL libraries and SQL

 Even better, you may have...

 • Ph.D. in Data Science, Statistics, Economics/Econometrics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field

jobs.description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.

 Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

 A Brief Overview
The Senior Health Plan Pricing Analyst is responsible for multiple tasks within the department including ensuring the appropriate medical rate is assigned for a prospect. This role uses specialized tools developed by third party industry experts and TriNet's carrier partners to evaluate submitted documents and census information to determine the correct medical pricing for prospects based on the actual risk they present. In addition, their role is to assist the manager with the training of new colleagues as well as a primary liaison with carriers and the carrier pricing teams. This role will be an expert in the field of PEO health plan pricing having mastered the nuances of pricing and is a key contributor to the team. This position is part of the development process for grooming colleagues into the next level of leadership within the Insurance Services team and the Health Plan Pricing department.

 What you will do

 • Work independently to determine an appropriate medical price based on the risk of the group using multiple tools such as the parity testing tool and medical pricing tool
• Conduct review of a prospect’s current medical offerings
• Ensure compliance with all carrier partner requirements
• Review complex cases such as self-funded groups and those over 100 employees
• Actively collaborate with Sales colleagues
• Assist is with reviewing and evaluating the output of the tools and resources TriNet uses
• Assist in training of new colleagues and ongoing training of new colleagues
• Other project and responsibilities may be added at the manager's discretion
• Performs other duties as assigned
• Complies with all policies and standards

 Education Qualifications

 • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience preferred

 Experience Qualifications

 • Typically 5+ years in insurance pricing or underwriting required

 Skills and Abilities

 • Exceptional knowledge of health plan pricing
• Ability to interpret and analyze detailed medical plans and related documents
• Experience with trend analysis, risk forecasting and claims evaluation
• Ability to interact with Sales to explain medical pricing guidelines, requirements, etc.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite; specifically with Excel
• Salesforce.com knowledge is preferred
• Ability to use mathematical skills to solve problems
• Demonstrates ability to exercise independent thinking and complete projects with little guidance
• Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize projects

 Travel Requirements
Minimal

 Work Environment

 • Work in clean, pleasant, and comfortable office or home setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 The preferred location for this role is Dublin, CA, and the salary range for this location is $85,000.00 to $159,250.00. All qualified external applicants will be considered for an in-office role, based in Dublin. All qualified internal candidates are encouraged to apply and consider relocation to Dublin and may be considered for remote hire at the company’s discretion. The candidate’s final salary offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, education, work location and experience.

 A candidate’s compensation may also include bonuses consistent with TriNet’s corporate bonus plan.
